text:
Maya Rivera: :wave: Quick sync — OrionBio asked for a compact get-to-prod lab for their data team next Wed. They want: a short prework packet, a 90m interactive workshop, and a 30m post-workshop "renewal health" checkpoint. Who can take prep + post-survey ownership?

Jon Patel: I can host the live session. Prefer 10:00–11:30am PT. Can we split hands-on exercises into 3x 20m rotations? :white_check_mark:

Priya Singh: I'd prefer 60m focused workshop + 30m follow-up office hours (more flexible for engineers). I'll own the prework doc (short checklist + sandbox creds).

Carlos Mendez: Important: capture renewal signals during the checkpoint — target questions about deployment timeline, perf SLOs, and billing expectations. I can draft a 1-page health checklist. Also flag any integration blockers.

Maya Rivera: Awesome. Priya + Carlos = prep + health checklist. Jon = live facilitation. I can own comms and the final calendar invite. Can we confirm time slot by EOD?

scheduler-bot: Available slots for next Wed (OrionBio):
- 09:00–10:30 PT
- 10:00–11:30 PT (Jon reserved)
- 13:00–14:30 PT
- 15:00–16:30 PT
Please react with :thumbsup: for the preferred slot.

Priya Singh: 10:00–11:30 PT :thumbsup: — keeps afternoon free for follow-ups.

Jon Patel: Confirmed. I'll post the runbook and the breakout exercise prompts this afternoon.

CS-Bot: Prework checklist template (use and send to customer):

```
Title: OrionBio - Get-to-Prod Prework
1) Confirm target model + dataset snapshot
2) Provide minimal infra access (read-only S3, test VPC CIDR)
3) Share a short list of success criteria (latency, throughput, accuracy)
4) Assign 1 engineer as point-of-contact for the day
5) Fill out short intake form: https://redwood-internal/onboard-intake
```

Please copy and paste before sending. :memo:

Carlos Mendez: For the renewal checkpoint, propose this template question set: 1) Are timelines for production deployment still realistic? 2) Any infra or security blockers? 3) Is the decision-maker alignment still intact? 4) Are budget expectations aligned? I will map answers to a risk score (low/medium/high).

Maya Rivera: Perfect. Also let's include a 3-question post-survey for NPS-ish feedback and adoption intent. Priya — can your prework include a 5-min micro-survey?

Priya Singh: Yep, I'll add a 5-min pre-survey and the 3-question post-survey. I can draft both by 4pm.

Jon Patel: I'll prepare two short labs: "quick deploy" (20m) and "observability checklist" (20m) and one optional deep-dive for infra (30m).

Maya Rivera: Logistics checklist before EOD:
- Priya: prework + surveys sent to OrionBio contact (copy Maya)
- Carlos: health-check draft for the checkpoint
- Jon: runbook + exercise assets
- Maya: final calendar invite + attendee list, set meeting to 10:00–11:30 PT, and add 30m follow-up at 16:00 PT as renewal checkpoint.

Carlos Mendez: I'll also prepare a short summary doc to attach to the checkpoint calendar item (one-pager + risk score).

scheduler-bot: Draft event created: "OrionBio: Get-to-Prod Lab (10:00–11:30 PT)" + "OrionBio: Renewal Health Check (16:00–16:30 PT)" — link: https://calendar.redwood/company/1749123456-orionbio-lab

Maya Rivera: Sending invite now. Please review attendees and add any SMEs. If anyone can't make it, we can record the session and run a follow-up deep-dive in the week. :calendar:

Jon Patel: I'll be on deck. Can someone add the billing contact to the checkpoint invite? That helps surface renewal questions.

Maya Rivera: Good call — adding finance contact Kate Lin to the 16:00 checkpoint.

Priya Singh: I'll send the prework + survey link in a separate email and post it here when done.

CS-Bot: Post-survey (short) template: 1) How confident do you feel about deploying in production? (1–5) 2) How satisfied with today's lab? (1–5) 3) Any blockers we should flag for the renewal checkpoint? (free text)

Maya Rivera: Thanks team — plan looks set. I'll close the loop after invites go out. :rocket:
